author: Warzone
body:
IGN: Warzone
Reason: Profanity/Disrespect

I was tempbanned for saying "wow noobs", do not get how that is a profanity word or such. Yes it may have been disrespectful but seriously getting hurt over the word "noobs" is lowkey. I was warned but I said it again okay it may have been a problem. The word "noob" might be disrespectful to some people and others wouldn't care at all. So, in my conclusion you may think that its disrespectful but it is not a profanity word. I did ask GrapeSmoothie if the word was profanity and he did say it wasn't a profanity word. I do understand my tempban.
Please reconsider the word "Noob" as its not profanity.
~Warzone
